project_context.domain: Real Estate Management Mobile App (Expo React Native)
project_context.target_audience: Brazilian Real Estate Brokers and Managers

rules.anti_default: Banned: Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, Lato for Headings. Use custom fonts via expo-font.
rules.hierarchy: Strict hierarchy. Jump between heading and subtitle must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.
rules.typesetting: Headlines use tracking-tight. Overlines/Labels use uppercase and tracking-[0.2em]. Line-height tight for headings, relaxed for body.

font_family.mono: IBM Plex Mono (for financial numbers, IGPM/IPCA rates)

rules.tinted_grey: All greys are slightly tinted with blue (Slate). No pure #000000 or #808080.
rules.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. Use APCA standards.
rules.no_gradients: No generic full-screen gradients. Use solid colors or very subtle linear gradients for premium cards.

layout_spacing.grid_system: Mobile-first layout. Standard horizontal padding: px-6.
layout_spacing.spacing_scale: p-1, p-2, p-4, p-6, p-8. Generous spacing philosophy. Elements must breathe.
layout_spacing.touch_targets: Minimum 48x48px for all interactive elements (buttons, icons, links).

surface_strategies.cards: Flat background, 1px solid border (#E2E8F0), no shadow default. Avoid heavy shadows. Sharp or max 8px rounded corners.
surface_strategies.headers: Solid background with 1px bottom border. Not transparent if content scrolls beneath.
surface_strategies.bottom_tabs: Fixed to bottom, solid background, high contrast active icon.

buttons.primary: Solid #0052FF background, white text, no rounded-full, use rounded-md or sharp.
buttons.interaction: React Native TouchableOpacity with activeOpacity={0.7} or Pressable with visual state changes.

inputs.text_input: Height 48px min. 1px solid #E2E8F0. Focus state: border #0052FF with 2px width.
inputs.financial_input: Must use IBM Plex Mono for digits. Right aligned or explicitly clear format for BRL (R$).

cards.kpi_card: Used for Dashboard. Padded (p-6). Large numeric value (text-3xl font-headings). Tiny uppercase label (text-xs).
cards.property_card: Image ratio 1:1 or 4:3. Full width on mobile. Price overlay or bold price text below image.

specific_flows.dashboard: Top Hero with total revenue/contracts. Horizontal scrollable list for quick KPI metrics (Imóveis ativos, Recebimentos). Bottom quick action FAB or grid.
specific_flows.property_listing: List view with thumbnail images (left) and details (right). Filter chips below the sticky header.
specific_flows.financial_calculator: Clear segmented controls (IGPM vs IPCA). Input fields with clear BRL/Percentage masks. Prominent 'Calculate' CTA.
specific_flows.contracts_receipts: Timeline view for contract status. One-tap 'Generate PDF/Share' actions using React Native Share API.

media_and_icons.icon_library: phosphor-react-native or lucide-react-native. Use sharp/regular weights. No duotone for dashboards.
media_and_icons.image_handling: Images must not exceed 60vh on mobile. Overlay text on images MUST have gradient scrim (bg-black/40).

instructions_to_main_agent.framework: Use Expo React Native. Use standard React Native Core components (View, Text, ScrollView). Use standard StyleSheet or NativeWind.
instructions_to_main_agent.files: Remember to use .js files as per environment constraints.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a testID attribute (React Native equivalent of data-testid). Example: testID="login-submit-button".
instructions_to_main_agent.navigation: Implement bottom tab navigation (Home, Properties, Clients, Finance) and stack navigation for details/forms.
instructions_to_main_agent.ui_libraries: Do NOT use DOM-specific Shadcn/UI directly since this is React Native. Re-create the specified design language natively respecting the tokens above.
instructions_to_main_agent.financials: Ensure data formatting modules account for Brazilian real currency formatting (R$) and correct IGPM/IPCA percentages.
